title: Small EA update on 4K account
author: Hot-Mixture109
selftext:
Small update on the gold bot’s latest run — 16 trading days, €4,000 starting capital, €1,183 profit. That’s a 29.58% return over the period, averaging out to roughly 1.85% per trading day (about 1.63% daily compounded).

What stood out to me in this stretch wasn’t the total number so much as the consistency — the average daily gain held pretty steady rather than coming from one or two outlier days. That’s usually the thing I care about more than the headline return, since it says more about the strategy’s edge than any single lucky trade.

comments.author: stereotomyalan
comments.body: bro leave some money for the rest of us
